title: Bowen 1747 coastal NC excerpt — approximate preview

source.title: New and accurate map of the provinces of North and South Carolina, Georgia etc. ...
source.publication: London: W. Innys, 1747; A complete system of Geography, map no.76; Hargrett guan_hmap_hmap1747b6
source.institution: Hargrett Rare Book and Manuscript Library, University of Georgia Libraries / Digital Library of Georgia
source.rights: No Copyright — United States (NoC-US), as supplied by the holding institution.
source.reference_source: USGS GNIS: frozen NC populated-place subset plus live landform query for three capes
source.method: Unweighted six-parameter affine in EPSG:32119, fit to five town proxies. Three cape checks and all source-pixel selections frozen before fitting. No checkpoint tuning.
limitations: Approximate coastal comparison only; no precise route, crossing or site identification.
Modern town centers do not establish exact colonial town locations.
Cape checks include unknown shoreline migration and point-definition uncertainty.
Sparse, predominantly coastal controls; interior/extrapolated geography is unvalidated.
Bowen serving raster is a coastal NC excerpt; full source scan remains available separately.
Historical source wording and depictions are retained as historical material.
source.mask: Source-pixel polygon explicitly recorded below; excludes decorative/non-geographic material for Wimble and restricts Bowen to coastal NC.
source.source_derivative: Institutional IIIF JPEG; native resolution for Wimble, 5000-pixel-wide derivative for Bowen.

accuracy_notice: Approximate historical-map alignment. For visual comparison only; not suitable for locating routes or sites precisely.
